description: Anonymized native ordinary Boomer S1/S2 zero-wind and tailwind path prefixes, conservatively trimmed before unknown special weather. Coordinates are relative to each path first point; originOffset is first native point minus the pre-shot muzzle. Session group numbers are arbitrary and preserve whole-session holdout boundaries.
limitations: Empirical ordinary-path evidence only; no headwind turn, SS, terrain-contact, hit-rate or special-weather guarantee.
